sources.description: According to ESPN’s lead NFL insider, Adam Schefter, the Denver Broncos have signed rookie 4th round pick Kage Casey to a four-year deal. 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis adds that Kasey signed a four-year contract worth $5.58M that includes a $1,198,208 signing bonus.
